---
title: "Unrestricted overall survival — hierarchical sensitivity results"
format: html
---

- Adjusted (fixed): lung indicator.
- Adjusted (hierarchical): diagnosis random intercepts and diagnosis-level imputation.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(rstanarm)
library(survival)
library(posterior)
library(ggsurvfit)
library(knitr)
library(here)
library(arrow)
library(yaml)
library(tidyverse)
source(here("R", "plot-style.R"))

config <- read_yaml(here("config", "analysis.yml"))
source(here("R", "survival.R"))

results_dir <- here(
  "analysis", "02-overall-survival", "05-unrestricted-hierarchical", "results"
)
figure_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "figures")
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

fixed_dir <- here(
  "analysis", "02-overall-survival", "04-unrestricted-follow-up", "results",
  "ph"
)

indices <- seq_len(config$imputation$m_supporting)

datasets <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "completed-datasets.rds"))
models <- map(indices, \(index) {
  readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "models", sprintf("model-%02d.rds", index)))
})
```

## Sampling diagnostics

```{r}
#| label: diagnostics
#| include: false

diagnostics <- map(indices, \(index) {
  model <- models[[index]]
  parameters <- summarise_draws(as_draws_array(model))
  sampler <- rstan::get_sampler_params(model$stanfit, inc_warmup = FALSE)
  expected <- datasets[[index]] |>
    filter(survival_time_days_unrestricted > 0)

  stopifnot(
    identical(model$data$id, expected$id),
    identical(
      model$data$survival_time_days_unrestricted,
      expected$survival_time_days_unrestricted
    ),
    identical(
      model$data$status_death_unrestricted,
      expected$status_death_unrestricted
    ),
    all(
      as.character(datasets[[index]]$diagnosis) %in%
        as.character(model$data$diagnosis)
    ),
    identical(model$cnms$diagnosis, "(Intercept)"),
    length(grep("^Sigma", colnames(as.matrix(model)))) == 1L
  )

  tibble(
    imputation = index,
    participants = nrow(model$data),
    max_rhat = max(parameters$rhat, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_ess_bulk = min(parameters$ess_bulk, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_ess_tail = min(parameters$ess_tail, na.rm = TRUE),
    divergences = sum(map_dbl(sampler, \(x) sum(x[, "divergent__"]))),
    treedepth_hits = sum(map_dbl(sampler, \(x) sum(x[, "treedepth__"] >= 10))),
    min_bfmi = min(map_dbl(sampler, \(x) {
      mean(diff(x[, "energy__"])^2) / var(x[, "energy__"])
    }))
  )
}) |>
  list_rbind()

stopifnot(
  all(diagnostics$max_rhat <= config$diagnostics$max_rhat),
  all(diagnostics$min_ess_bulk >= config$diagnostics$min_ess_bulk),
  all(diagnostics$min_ess_tail >= config$diagnostics$min_ess_tail),
  all(diagnostics$divergences == 0),
  all(diagnostics$treedepth_hits == 0),
  all(diagnostics$min_bfmi >= config$diagnostics$min_bfmi)
)
```

## Hazard ratio

```{r}
#| label: hazard-ratio
#| include: false

hr_draws <- map(indices, \(index) {
  set.seed(4300L + index)

  tibble(
    imputation = index,
    draw = 1:1000,
    hazard_ratio = sample(exp(as.matrix(models[[index]], pars = "tx")), 1000L)
  )
}) |>
  list_rbind()

stopifnot(
  nrow(hr_draws) == 1000L * config$imputation$m_supporting,
  all(count(hr_draws, imputation)$n == 1000L)
)

hr_summary <- hr_draws |>
  summarise(
    adjustment = "Adjusted (hierarchical)",
    median = median(hazard_ratio),
    lower_95 = quantile(hazard_ratio, 0.025),
    upper_95 = quantile(hazard_ratio, 0.975),
    probability_hr_below_one = mean(hazard_ratio < 1)
  )
```

## Standardized survival curves

```{r}
#| label: survival-curves
#| include: false

# Survival times are identical across imputations, so dataset 1 suffices.
observed <- datasets[[1]]
max_follow_up <- max(observed$survival_time_days_unrestricted)

curves <- map(indices, \(index) {
  posterior_standardized_survival_draws(
    models[[index]],
    datasets[[index]],
    horizon = max_follow_up,
    n_points = 200L,
    n_draws = 1000L,
    seed = 4300L + index
  ) |>
    mutate(imputation = index)
}) |>
  list_rbind()

curve_summary <- curves |>
  summarise(
    median = median(survival),
    lower_95 = quantile(survival, 0.025),
    upper_95 = quantile(survival, 0.975),
    .by = c(tx, time)
  ) |>
  mutate(adjustment = "Adjusted (hierarchical)")
```

## Prediction checks

```{r}
#| label: prediction-checks
#| include: false

checks <- map(indices, \(index) {
  newdata <- datasets[[index]] |>
    mutate(tx = 1)

  individual <- posterior_survfit_compatible(
    models[[index]],
    newdata = newdata,
    times = 182,
    extrapolate = FALSE,
    standardise = FALSE,
    return_matrix = TRUE,
    draws = 100L,
    seed = 4301L
  )[[1]]

  standardized <- posterior_survfit_compatible(
    models[[index]],
    newdata = newdata,
    times = 182,
    extrapolate = FALSE,
    standardise = TRUE,
    return_matrix = TRUE,
    draws = 100L,
    seed = 4301L
  )[[1]]

  error <- max(abs(rowMeans(individual) - as.numeric(standardized)))

  # One row per diagnosis, otherwise identical.
  contrast_data <- newdata[rep(1L, nlevels(newdata$diagnosis)), ]
  contrast_data$diagnosis <- factor(
    levels(newdata$diagnosis),
    levels = levels(newdata$diagnosis)
  )

  predictions <- posterior_survfit_compatible(
    models[[index]],
    newdata = contrast_data,
    times = 182,
    extrapolate = FALSE,
    standardise = FALSE,
    return_matrix = TRUE,
    draws = 100L,
    seed = 4301L
  )[[1]]

  diagnosis_contrast <- max(apply(predictions, 1, \(x) diff(range(x))))

  stopifnot(error < 1e-10, diagnosis_contrast > 1e-8)

  tibble(
    imputation = index,
    maximum_averaging_error = error,
    maximum_diagnosis_contrast = diagnosis_contrast
  )
}) |>
  list_rbind()
```

## Comparison with Adjusted (fixed), cohort and diagnosis balance

```{r}
#| label: comparison
#| include: false

fixed_hr <- read_parquet(
  file.path(fixed_dir, "hazard-ratio-summary.parquet")
) |>
  transmute(
    adjustment = "Adjusted (fixed)",
    median,
    lower_95 = ci_95_low,
    upper_95 = ci_95_high,
    probability_hr_below_one = probability_benefit
  )

comparison <- bind_rows(fixed_hr, hr_summary)

fixed_curves <- read_parquet(
  file.path(fixed_dir, "survival-curve-summary.parquet")
) |>
  transmute(
    tx,
    time,
    median,
    lower_95 = lower,
    upper_95 = upper,
    adjustment = "Adjusted (fixed)"
  )

comparison_curves <- bind_rows(fixed_curves, curve_summary)

cohort_summary <- observed |>
  summarise(
    randomized = n(),
    positive_follow_up = sum(survival_time_days_unrestricted > 0),
    deaths = sum(status_death_unrestricted),
    .by = tx
  )

diagnosis_balance <- observed |>
  count(diagnosis, tx, .drop = FALSE) |>
  mutate(percent = 100 * n / sum(n), .by = tx) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = tx,
    values_from = c(n, percent),
    values_fill = 0
  ) |>
  mutate(difference_percentage_points = percent_1 - percent_0) |>
  arrange(desc(abs(difference_percentage_points)))
```

```{r}
#| label: write-results
#| include: false

write_parquet(hr_draws, file.path(results_dir, "hazard-ratio-draws.parquet"))
write_parquet(
  hr_summary,
  file.path(results_dir, "hazard-ratio-summary.parquet")
)
write_parquet(comparison, file.path(results_dir, "comparison.parquet"))
write_parquet(
  curve_summary,
  file.path(results_dir, "survival-curve-summary.parquet")
)
write_parquet(diagnostics, file.path(results_dir, "diagnostics.parquet"))
write_parquet(checks, file.path(results_dir, "prediction-checks.parquet"))
write_parquet(cohort_summary, file.path(results_dir, "cohort-summary.parquet"))
write_parquet(
  diagnosis_balance,
  file.path(results_dir, "diagnosis-balance.parquet")
)
write_parquet(
  curves,
  file.path(results_dir, "standardized-survival-draws.parquet")
)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-os-hierarchical-survival
#| fig-cap: "Standardized unrestricted OS by adjustment approach; bands show 95% credible intervals"
#| fig-alt: "Usual-care and ctDNA survival curves comparing fixed adjustment with hierarchical diagnosis adjustment."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4.5
#| echo: false

survival_plot <- comparison_curves |>
  mutate(tx = group_factor(tx)) |>
  ggplot(aes(time, median, colour = tx, fill = tx)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower_95, ymax = upper_95), alpha = 0.15, colour = NA) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~adjustment) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, max_follow_up, by = 200)) +
  scale_colour_group() +
  scale_fill_group() +
  labs(
    x = "Days since random selection",
    y = "Survival probability",
    colour = NULL,
    fill = NULL
  )

save_figure(
  survival_plot,
  file.path(figure_dir, "standardized-survival.png"),
  height = 4.5
)

survival_plot
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-os-hierarchical-km
#| fig-cap: "Observed unrestricted OS with censor marks, numbers at risk, and cumulative deaths every 100 days"
#| fig-alt: "Kaplan–Meier curves for both randomized groups with at-risk and cumulative-event counts at 100-day intervals."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 6.5
#| echo: false

observed <- observed |>
  mutate(tx_label = group_factor(tx))

km_fit <- survfit2(
  Surv(survival_time_days_unrestricted, status_death_unrestricted) ~ tx_label,
  data = observed
)
risk_times <- seq(0, max_follow_up, by = 100)

# theme = NULL: use the report theme instead of ggsurvfit's own.
km_plot <- ggsurvfit(km_fit, theme = NULL) +
  add_confidence_interval() +
  add_censor_mark() +
  scale_colour_group() +
  scale_fill_group() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = risk_times) +
  add_risktable(
    times = risk_times,
    risktable_stats = c("n.risk", "cum.event"),
    stats_label = list(n.risk = "At risk", cum.event = "Events")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Days since random selection",
    y = "Survival probability",
    colour = NULL,
    fill = NULL
  )

save_figure(
  ggsurvfit_build(km_plot),
  file.path(figure_dir, "kaplan-meier.png"),
  height = 6.5
)

km_plot
```
